title: PhD in Physical AI for Robotics 2027 — Aarhus University, Denmark
intro: Fully funded three-year PhD at Aarhus University in Physical AI, developing adaptive foundation models for robotics with multimodal perception and reasoning.
description:
Project Overview

Aarhus University invites applications for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at the Graduate School of Technical Sciences within the Electrical and Computer Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 January 2027 or later, with a preferred starting date of 1 January 2027.

The project connects multimodal perception, reasoning, and action with predictive learning and edge intelligence, developing adaptive foundation models for robotic systems that can operate under distribution shift and real-world conditions.

Research position overview

This three-year PhD position is based in the A3 Lab (Adaptive & Agentic AI) led by Assoc. Prof. Alexandros Iosifidis. You will work on world models and safe test-time adaptation of robotic foundation models, with applications in autonomous robotics and mission-critical systems.

Research Areas

  • Physical AI and embodied intelligence
  • Adaptive foundation models for robotics
  • Multimodal perception and reasoning
  • Predictive learning and world models
  • Edge intelligence and safe test-time adaptation
